def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sevens = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 7]
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]

    vertical = next((p for p in markers if p[0] in (0, h - 1)), None)
    horizontal = next((p for p in markers if p[1] in (0, w - 1)), None)
    out = [[1] * w for _ in range(h)]

    if vertical and horizontal:
        vaxis = vertical[1]
        haxis = horizontal[0]

        top = [p for p in sevens if p[0] < haxis]
        bottom = [p for p in sevens if p[0] > haxis]
        left = [p for p in sevens if p[1] < vaxis]
        right = [p for p in sevens if p[1] > vaxis]

        dr_top = -min(r for r, c in top) if top else 0
        dr_bottom = h - 1 - max(r for r, c in bottom) if bottom else 0
        dc_left = -min(c for r, c in left) if left else 0
        dc_right = w - 1 - max(c for r, c in right) if right else 0

        for r, c in sevens:
            nr = r + (dr_top if r < haxis else dr_bottom if r > haxis else 0)
            nc = c + (dc_left if c < vaxis else dc_right if c > vaxis else 0)
            out[nr][nc] = 7

        axis_rows = [r for r in range(h) if out[r][vaxis] == 7]
        if axis_rows:
            rows = range(0, max(axis_rows) + 1) if vertical[0] == 0 else range(min(axis_rows), h)
            for r in rows:
                if out[r][vaxis] != 7:
                    out[r][vaxis] = 2

        axis_cols = [c for c in range(w) if out[haxis][c] == 7]
        if axis_cols:
            cols = range(0, max(axis_cols) + 1) if horizontal[1] == 0 else range(min(axis_cols), w)
            for c in cols:
                if out[haxis][c] != 7:
                    out[haxis][c] = 2

        return out

    if vertical:
        mr, axis = vertical
        topward = mr == 0
        axis_cells = [(r, c) for r, c in sevens if c == axis]

        for side, cells in (
            ("left", [(r, c) for r, c in sevens if c < axis]),
            ("right", [(r, c) for r, c in sevens if c > axis]),
        ):
            if not cells:
                continue
            r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
            dr = -r0 if topward else h - 1 - r1
            dc = -c0 if side == "left" else w - 1 - c1
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r + dr][c + dc] = 7

        for r, c in axis_cells:
            out[r][c] = 7
        if axis_cells:
            rows = range(0, max(r for r, c in axis_cells) + 1) if topward else range(min(r for r, c in axis_cells), h)
            for r in rows:
                if out[r][axis] != 7:
                    out[r][axis] = 2

    elif horizontal:
        axis, mc = horizontal
        leftward = mc == 0
        axis_cells = [(r, c) for r, c in sevens if r == axis]

        for side, cells in (
            ("top", [(r, c) for r, c in sevens if r < axis]),
            ("bottom", [(r, c) for r, c in sevens if r > axis]),
        ):
            if not cells:
                continue
            r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
            dr = -r0 if side == "top" else h - 1 - r1
            dc = -c0 if leftward else w - 1 - c1
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r + dr][c + dc] = 7

        for r, c in axis_cells:

            for c in cols:
                if out[axis][c] != 7:
                    out[axis][c] = 2

    return out
